$comment: Reviewed policy inputs for the content-scopes/v1 contract generator.
Every value here is either (a) an owner decision recorded in decisions.md, or
(b) an observed fact about currently deployed authorization, cited to a pinned source file.
The generator never infers policy from the spreadsheet's 'API Family' or 'Proposed scope' columns alone.

scopeMap.$comment: D1. Column F labels are DISPLAY labels; these are the proposed machine names.

scopeDescriptions.content.audio.read: Reciters, recitations, audio files, timing/lookup, recitation information and styles.
scopeDescriptions.content.quran.read: Chapters, structure, pages, verses and scripts.
scopeDescriptions.content.hadith.read: Hadith references, text and range counts.
scopeDescriptions.content.translations.read: Translation catalogs, information, verse translations and footnotes.
scopeDescriptions.content.metadata.read: Languages and verse media. Distinct from, and much narrower than, content.sync.read.
scopeDescriptions.content.sync.read: Public content delta sync and resource snapshots. NOT the existing user-data 'sync' scope.
scopeDescriptions.content.reflections.read: The five public QuranReflect reads only. Grants no private posts, my-posts, private rooms, user-specific feeds, mutations or moderation.
scopeDescriptions.content.answers.read: Answers by ayah, answer detail and range counts.

rules.note: Wildcard fallback. No explicit per-route content entry exists today except Qiraat, which is out of scope.
'post' is genuinely accepted here today. Migration eligibility must be evaluated against these actual alternatives, never against an assumed scope hierarchy.

deprecatedForNewClients.$comment: D5. Still valid for existing identities; not issuable to new ones once v1 policy is active.

$comment: A5. Quota buckets are snapshotted from today's behavior and are deliberately NOT the
authorization alternatives. Today checkRateLimit() iterates the matched scope list, so
adding granular scopes to authorization would silently add new buckets and could split or
double-charge an aggregate allowance. quotaBuckets freezes the pre-migration bucket set.
Source: src/libs/rate-limit.ts :: checkRateLimit (plus the always-charged global '' bucket).

authContexts.$comment: Distinguishes the public app-credential surface from the user-token surface for the same controller operation.

environmentMap.$comment: Column L values normalized. Branch names and GitHub environment labels are NOT environments; see plan section 6A.

$comment: D4. v1 defines scopes as endpoint-family permissions, not strict data-family isolation.
Quran verse endpoints may still embed translations/tafsirs/audio, and content sync snapshots
may return full resources across content types. Strict isolation requires a different,
field-aware design and a revised migration equivalence; it is not activated by this contract.
A6. C8 is the eight table scopes other than content.reflections.read.
Eligibility is decided per operation by intersecting the client's CURRENT effective scope set
with that operation's observed legacyAnyOf. This is finite and mechanical: it never treats a
'content.' string prefix as authorization and never assumes a parent/child hierarchy.

c8Rule.note: A content.create-only client has no intersection and therefore gains no read successors.

reflectionsRule.note: Eligible only when the client's scopes intersect the legacyAnyOf of ALL five public reflection routes. Narrow clients therefore need post.read AND comment.read. A client holding only the 'post' umbrella does satisfy this, because 'post' is an accepted alternative on all five routes today. 'content' alone never satisfies it.

$comment: D5. Replaces only the legacy content-read component of the existing environment baseline.
Unrelated pre-existing baseline entries are retained verbatim by the Platform policy code;
this contract does not enumerate them and must not be used to widen them.
Inspected production baseline already includes post.read and comment.read alongside
content and offline_access: quran/qf-platform-api src/developer_repository.rs.
Revalidate on the implementation branch before activation.

outOfScope.$comment: A3. Never granted as content successors, and never merged with the new scopes.
outOfScope.note: Qiraat keeps its explicit gateway route policy and precedence. The existing user-data 'sync' scope is unrelated to content.sync.read.
